cards.text: The work on God's house in Jerusalem had stopped, and it stayed at a standstill until the second year of the reign of Darius king of Persia (Ezra 4:24). Later, two prophets, Haggai and Zechariah son of Iddo, prophesy to the Jews in Judah and Jerusalem. They speak in the name of the God of Israel, who was over them.
Now meet Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel and Jeshua son of Jozadak, two men the exiles came home from Babylon with (Ezra 2:1-2), and Jeshua's a priest (Ezra 3:2). These two just heard the prophets speak.

cards.question: Haggai and Zechariah have spoken. Now what do Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel and Jeshua son of Jozadak do?

answers.text: Rise up and rebuild God's house

cards.question: True or false: Once the building starts back up, the prophets of God go home and leave the builders on their own.

cards.text: Then Tattenai, the governor of the region west of the Euphrates, shows up with Shethar-bozenai and their associates. Friend, when the governor walks in with his WHOLE crew, nobody's there to drop off cookies.

cards.question: Tattenai and his crew have a question for the builders at the temple. What do they want to know?

answers.text: How much the building will cost
When the building will be finished

cards.question: Tattenai's crew also asks for the ___ of the men constructing the building.
True or false: Tattenai's crew stops the temple work right away.
Tattenai's crew doesn't stop the work. Whose eye was on the elders of the Jews, so that they weren't stopped?

cards.text: So a report goes off to King Darius, and the work keeps going while everyone waits for written instructions to come back. Friend, I spent YEARS in the back of a junk drawer waiting on somebody else to decide what happened to me.
Here's Tattenai's actual letter, and it opens real polite: "To King Darius: All peace." He tells the king the people are rebuilding with large stones and placing timbers in the walls.

cards.question: True or false: In his letter to King Darius, Tattenai says the temple work is being carried out diligently and is prospering.

cards.text: Then Tattenai tells the king what his crew asked: who authorized this, and what are the leaders' names, so they could write them down for the king. The man showed up to a building project and started a SIGN-IN SHEET.
Now Tattenai's letter gives the elders' answer, and friend, they did not come with a one-word reply. Somebody asks who said they could do this, and these men pull out the WHOLE history.

cards.question: The elders start their answer to Tattenai by saying who they are. What do they call themselves?

answers.text: Servants of the God of heaven and earth
Servants of the great King Darius
Servants of the governor of Judah

cards.question: The elders say they're rebuilding a temple from many years ago, one that a great ___ of Israel built and completed.

cards.text: Then the elders tell the hard part. Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, the Chaldean, destroyed this temple and carried the people away to Babylon.

cards.question: According to the elders, why did God deliver their fathers into Nebuchadnezzar's hand?

answers.text: Their fathers angered the God of heaven
Their fathers left the temple unfinished
Their fathers moved God's house elsewhere

cards.question: The elders' story turns hopeful. In the first year of his reign, a king issued a decree to rebuild this house of God. Which king?

cards.text: Cyrus also takes the gold and silver articles Nebuchadnezzar carried off from God's house in Jerusalem right back out of the temple of Babylon. One king walks off with your stuff and a DIFFERENT king pulls it back out, and friend, that just doesn't happen.

cards.question: Cyrus hands those gold and silver articles to a man he appoints as governor. Who is it?
True or false: Cyrus tells Sheshbazzar to let the house of God be rebuilt on its original site.
So Sheshbazzar comes to Jerusalem and lays the ___ of the house of God.
True or false: The elders tell Tattenai that the house of God is now completed.

cards.text: Tattenai's done passing along the elders' answer, and now he wraps up his letter with a request for King Darius. Basically: these folks say the old king already signed off on this, so could somebody PLEASE go check?

cards.question: Tattenai asks for a search of the royal ___ in Babylon, to see if King Cyrus really did issue that decree.

cards.text: Then he asks the king to send back his decision, so now it's all in King Darius's hands. Friend, I spent years buried under old paper in a junk drawer, so I'm rooting HARD for that decree, and this story is NOT done.
